author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Home editorial path is duplicated between the allowlist rule and the page request builder.
findings.consequence: If the Home editorial URL changes in only one place, the page can request a path that managedHomeTextRules rejects, silently falling back to empty Home content.
findings.evidence: managedHomeTextRules allows only homeEditorialPath through allowedPaths at line 23, while app/pages/index.vue independently declares const contentPath = "/red/om/start/startsida-ny.html" and uses it to build the fetchManagedText URL before passing managedHomeTextRules(authorityOrigin).
findings.recommendation: Export a single Home editorial path constant and use it from app/pages/index.vue, or have the rule helper expose/build the canonical request path so request and allowlist cannot drift.

verification: Read-only inspection only; did not run tests.
